::: {.callout-important title="This is a three-chapter pilot, not the complete workbook"}
This document contains **only Chapters 1, 2, and 3** of *Modern LLM
Architecture: A Visual Guide to Attention, Memory, Sparsity, and Hybrid
Models* (workbook 04 of the ML/LLM Study Workbooks series). Chapters
4-8 -- restricting attention's reach, mixture-of-experts models, case
studies, architecture -> systems consequences, and a synthesis/practice
chapter -- are planned but **not drafted**. Nothing in this document
should be read as implying those chapters exist yet. Chapter 3 also
does not yet cover multi-head latent attention (MLA); that mechanism
was deliberately deferred out of chapter 3's drafting pass (see
`outline.yaml`'s `ch3.drafting_note`) and its eventual chapter
placement is not yet decided.

This is a review artifact: it exists to establish the workbook's
explanatory depth, visual language, page density, question style, and
citation style before the remaining chapters are drafted at scale.
Treat any rough edge you find as exactly the kind of thing this pilot
is meant to surface early.
:::
